preventativeNutritionSystem.narrative_synthesis: OldBoy inherited a Double Coat from their Labrador Retriever ancestry. While advantageous for environmental adaptation and physiological resilience, in a Temperate Indoor environment, this trait presents specific management considerations, such as a 18.5% incidence of Obesity observed in Labrador Retriever (Source: Canine Lifestyle Outcomes Study). To proactively manage this, lifestyle modifications including Structured interval walks are recommended. Furthermore, based on veterinary physiology, targeted nutritional intervention with L-Carnitine is required at a dosage of 250 to support long-term health.
